name: repeat-end
description: An end-repeat barline with two dots followed by thin and thick bars.
useCase: Mark the end of a passage to repeat in a musical score.
misuse: Use repeat for looping media playback.

16.reason: Two full dots precede the complete thin bar and a solid heavy bar with no cramped interior.

24.reason: The conventional dot pair and thin-heavy bar order stay separate at interface size.
